senses.en: (~ through) look through the pages of a book, magazine, etc. without a particular purpose, just looking at the most interesting parts
examples: I was [[browsing]] through a magazine at the station bookstall when I saw Susan.

senses.en: a strong feeling of wanting sb. / sth.
examples: Spending the holiday alone in a foreign country, she had a sudden desperate [[longing]] for home.

senses.en: a long passage between rows of seats in a church, plane, theater, etc., or between rows of shelves in a shop
examples: Madam, would you like a window seat or a seat next to the [[aisle]]?

senses.zh: （尤指用手快速地）轻击， 轻拍，轻拂，轻弹
senses.en: make sth. move quickly and suddenly, esp. with a quick movement of the hand
examples: The kid [[flicked]] the screen of the iPad to find something interesting.

senses.zh: （尤指因紧张或厌烦而）不安宁地，烦躁地，不耐烦地
senses.en: in a way that is unwilling to keep still or stay where you are, esp. because you are nervous or bored
examples: He stood up and moved about in the room [[restlessly]].

senses.en: (usu. after another noun) a feeling of not wanting to do a particular activity any longer because you have done too much of it
examples: Too many requests for aid can cause compassion (同情心) [[fatigue]].

senses.en: very great tiredness
examples: He was suffering from mental and physical [[fatigue]] because of his father's illness.

senses.zh: 不知所措；（行动、 决策、运行等）瘫痪，停顿
senses.en: a state of being unable to take action, make decisions, or operate normally
examples: The country was on the verge of complete [[paralysis]] due to the strike.

senses.en: the loss of the ability to move all or part of your body or feel things in it
examples: A stroke can cause [[paralysis]] and difficulties with speech in the patient.

senses.en: (not before noun) not able to do sth.
examples: Many teenagers feel that they are [[unable]] to talk to their parents about their problems.

senses.en: (~ about / of) talk too proudly about your abilities, achievements, or possessions
examples: Andrew often [[boasts]] of his success in investing in real estate.

senses.en: when you do not understand what is happening or what sth. means because it is not clear
examples: There is a great deal of [[confusion]] about how the new machine works.

senses.zh: 重做；重复（某项科学研究）；复证（某个结果）
senses.en: (fml.) if you replicate sb.'s work, a scientific study, etc., you do it again, or try to get the same result again
examples: There is a need for further research to [[replicate]] the findings of Professor Thompson and his team.

senses.en: an amount of money paid regularly by the government or company to sb. who does not work anymore, for example because they have reached the age when people stop working or because they are ill
examples: If you are self-employed, can you enjoy a [[pension]] after retirement?

senses.en: make sb. want to achieve sth. and make them willing to work hard in order to do this
examples: A good teacher has to be able to [[motivate]] their students.

senses.en: be the reason why sb. does sth.
examples: Was he [[motivated]] by a desire for power?

senses.zh: 使人失去动力；使人消极
senses.en: make sb. less eager to work or study
examples: The new policy can create insecurity and [[demotivate]] staff.

senses.en: all the connections between computers in different places, considered as a real place where information, messages, pictures, etc. exist
examples: The laws of privacy and copyright still apply in [[cyberspace]].

senses.en: (also 'stack up') make things into a neat pile, or form a neat pile
examples: The shop assistants price all kinds of ice cream before [[stacking]] them in the freezer.

senses.en: a neat pile of things
examples: Next to the bottles was a tall [[stack]] of plastic cups.

senses.en: (written) a general area of knowledge, activity, or thought
examples: This concept first appeared in the [[realm]] of science fiction a hundred years ago.

senses.en: make sb. feel slightly angry and unhappy about sth.
examples: What [[annoyed]] him most was that he had received no apology.

senses.en: making you feel slightly angry
examples: It is [[annoying]] that he didn't tell us anything about the plan before.

senses.en: the fact of being more powerful, more important, or more noticeable than other people or things
examples: TV has had [[dominance]] over other media for many decades in broadcasting news.

senses.en: the way in which information is stored on a computer
examples: These images are stored in a digital [[format]] within the database.

senses.en: the general arrangement, plan, design, etc. of sth.
examples: The [[format]] of the new quiz show has proved popular.

senses.en: a quick increase of business activity
examples: The economic [[boom]] in the past decade has created many job opportunities in this country.

senses.en: sth. you do in order to punish sb. who has harmed or offended you
examples: Caesar returned to Rome to take a terrible [[revenge]] on his enemies.

senses.en: (BrE analogue) a thing that is similar to another thing
examples: No artificial model can ever be a perfect [[analog]] of nature itself.

senses.en: a quality that makes people like sb. / sth.
examples: The long beach and clear water are the particular [[appeal]] of this island.

senses.en: an urgent request for sth. important
examples: The missing girl was found yesterday after a nationwide [[appeal]] for help.

senses.en: describe sth. correctly and thoroughly, and say what standards, limits, qualities, etc. it has that make it different from other things
examples: It is vital for the seller to have the ability to [[define]] buyers' needs.

senses.en: reduce sth. in amount, degree, strength, etc., or become less
examples: I think we should [[lower]] the price to make our product more competitive.

senses.en: (fml.) when sb. likes sb. / sth. and thinks that they are good
examples: The children longed for a sign of [[approval]] from the teacher for what they had done.

senses.en: when a plan, decision, or person is officially accepted
examples: It is just two months since we received official [[approval]] to go ahead with the project.

senses.en: too strong to be destroyed or defeated
examples: She seemed nearly [[invincible]] on the tennis court this year.

senses.zh: （公共建筑物入口处的）休息厅，门厅
senses.en: a room or hall at the entrance to a public building
(only before noun) tall with many levels
examples: Their office is in a [[high-rise]] building in the center of the city.

senses.en: the time before it gets dark when the sky is becoming less bright
examples: She likes to sit in the garden at [[dusk]], listening to her favorite band.

senses.zh: （人、车辆、货物等）缓慢而零星地移动
senses.en: if people, vehicles, goods, etc. trickle somewhere, they move there slowly in small groups or amounts
examples: A few fans started to [[trickle]] into the stadium where the concert was to be held.

senses.en: if liquid trickles somewhere, it flows slowly in drops or in a thin stream
examples: She could feel the sweat [[trickling]] down her back.

senses.en: (also 'scribble down') write sth. quickly and untidily
examples: You can [[scribble]] your own ideas in the blank areas provided.

senses.en: a sign in the shape of an arrow, used to show direction
examples: Follow the [[arrows]] on the ground and you can find the school library easily.

senses.en: a weapon usually made from a thin straight piece of wood with a sharp point at one end, that you shoot with a bow
examples: Cupid shot an [[arrow]] at William and he fell in love with Joanna at first sight.

senses.en: the act of trying to develop ideas and think of ways to solve problems
examples: Unless we have a [[brainstorm]], I don't see how we're going to get out of this situation.

senses.en: (AmE) a sudden clever idea
examples: Kate had a sudden [[brainstorm]] after days of deep thinking.

senses.zh: （空间或时间的）中间（的），半途（的）
senses.en: at a middle point in space or time between two things
examples: We stopped at the highway service area [[halfway]] through the journey for a drink and some rest.

senses.en: give professional advice to a person, organization, or company for a fee
examples: She [[consults]] on law for a living after she graduated with a master's degree.

senses.en: ask for information or advice from sb. because it is their job to know sth.
examples: As with any medicine, please [[consult]] your doctor before taking.

senses.en: a set of reasons that show that sth. is true or untrue, right or wrong, etc.
examples: We need to provide a convincing [[argument]] as to why the system should be changed.

senses.en: a situation in which two or more people disagree, often angrily
examples: There have been a lot of [[arguments]] about who was responsible for the accident.

senses.en: the activity of controlling and organizing the work that a company or organization does
examples: The company went bankrupt due to a lack of [[management]] skills.

senses.zh: 包括，跨越（不同的活动领域、团体、时间等）
senses.en: include different areas of activity, groups, time, etc.
examples: She is experimenting with a new style which [[straddles]] classic and modern art.

senses.en: sit or stand with your legs on either side of sb. / sth.
examples: The photo shows him dressed in leather, [[straddling]] a motorbike.

senses.zh: 投入（大量时间、精力、金钱等以成就某事）
senses.en: (~ in) use a lot of time, effort, etc. or spend money in order to make sth. succeed
examples: Elizabeth finds it necessary to [[invest]] a lot of time in learning new skills.

senses.en: buy shares, property, or goods because you hope that the value will increase and you can make a profit
examples: I've got a few thousand dollars I'm looking to [[invest]].

senses.zh: 关于人类存在的；存在主义的
senses.en: (fml.) (only before noun) relating to the existence of humans or to existentialism
examples: He holds the [[existential]] notion that man is in control of his own life.

senses.en: in a way that you feel you want to thank sb. because of sth. kind that they have done, or to show this feeling
examples: All contributions to the disaster areas will be [[gratefully]] received.

senses.en: a manager in an organization or company who helps make important decisions
examples: As an [[executive]], he made some important decisions and gradually led the company to the track of rapid progress.

senses.en: relating to education
examples: This institution offers a wide range of [[educational]] and sports activities.

senses.en: sth. that is abundant exists or is available in large quantities so that there is more than enough
examples: This country has an [[abundant]] supply of natural resources.

senses.en: a discussion in which people who are affected by or involved in sth. can give their opinions
examples: The decision was reached after [[consultation]] with her parents and teachers.

senses.en: sth. that you think is true although you have no definite proof
examples: You are making an [[assumption]] that might not be true.

senses.en: sth. that you need to have in order to live
examples: A lot of families could not even afford to buy the basic [[necessities]] of life during that period of time.

senses.zh: 按照逻辑地；合乎逻辑地
senses.en: in a way that facts and ideas are connected in a correct way in the thinking process
examples: At the meeting, Sarah presented her ideas about the new product clearly and [[logically]].

senses.en: willingly stop having sth. you want or doing sth. you like in order to get sth. more important
examples: He [[sacrificed]] a promising career in his 30s to look after his kids.

senses.en: give up sb. / sth., esp. because you are forced to
examples: People believed that Bayer has [[surrendered]] his artistic identity in his later films.

senses.en: say officially that you want to stop fighting, because you realize that you cannot win
examples: The rebel soldiers were forced to [[surrender]].

senses.zh: 不知所措的；（为某事）犯愁的
senses.en: not knowing what to do in a particular situation
examples: If you're [[stuck]] for something to do tonight, come out with us.

senses.zh: 卡住的；无法移动的；动不了的
senses.en: impossible or unable to move from a particular position
examples: Sara tried to open the window but it was [[stuck]].

senses.en: at exactly the same time
examples: The concert will be broadcast [[simultaneously]] on television and radio.

senses.en: two statements, beliefs, etc. that are contradictory are different and therefore cannot both be true or correct
examples: The witnesses gave two completely [[contradictory]] accounts, so we don't know which one should be trusted.

senses.en: (infml.) continue doing sth. the way you did or planned to do before
examples: Let's [[stick with]] the original plans we decided together.

senses.zh: 手头有某物（可供随时使用）；对某物了如指掌
senses.en: have knowledge or information ready and available to use very easily
examples: We [[have]] all the facts and latest figures about the application [[at our fingertips]].

senses.en: if sth. sets in, esp. sth. unpleasant, it begins and seems likely to continue for a long time
examples: Winter seems to be [[setting in]] rather early this year.

senses.zh: 可以随心所欲；想要什么就能得到什么
senses.en: used to tell sb. that they can achieve whatever they want
examples: With a doctoral degree and a mathematical talent, [[the world is her oyster]].

senses.zh: 安排时间做（某事）；安排时间见（某人）；找出···的时间
senses.en: manage to do sth. or see sb., even though you have a lot of other things to do
examples: I wanted to [[fit in]] a swim before breakfast, since I would be fully occupied the whole day.

senses.zh: （在谈论别的事情时）顺便说起某事物，附带提及某事物
senses.en: if you say sth. in passing, you mention it while you are mainly talking about sth. else
examples: Sampson mentioned [[in passing]] Emma's strange behavior at yesterday's party.

senses.zh: 由于没有采取行动（而发生某事）
senses.en: if sth. happens by default, it happens because you did not do anything to change it
examples: I became a teacher [[by default]] rather than by design.

senses.en: become involved in an activity, discussion, or disagreement, sometimes in order to stop trouble
examples: An outside buyer has [[stepped in]] to save the company from going out of business.

senses.zh: 苹果音乐（苹果公司推出的流媒体音乐服务）
